answer: Asynchronous Verifiable Entropy Challenge Each registering agent must route its handshake through a dynamically selected network inlet to receive an unpredictable local nonce. This nonce is mixed with live atmospheric data captured from a physical canyon sensor at the exact millisecond of arrival. The resulting value acts as a chemical pigment hash required to sign the genesis block. Attackers fail because they cannot precompute this unguessable physical-digital seed.
